metaTitle: Custom Microwave Safe Cafe Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom microwave safe cafe mugs for your office or event. Perfect for hot beverages. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Microwave safe cafe mugs let your team or clients heat their coffee or tea directly in the mug without transferring to another vessel. This convenience is essential for busy offices where employees grab a quick warm-up between meetings. Our ceramic and stoneware options handle repeated microwave use without cracking, and they provide a smooth surface for full-color logo imprinting. Choose from standard 11 oz or larger 15 oz sizes to suit your group's drinking habits.
